name: firstai-local-agent
description: 100% local agentic AI app with Next.js, FastAPI, SQLite, and Ollama.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && python3 -m venv backend/.venv && backend/.venv/bin/pip install -r backend/requirements.txt
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "backend/.venv/bin/uvicorn main:app --app-dir backend --reload --port 8000"
